title: 23-BCV-014 — Multi-level storage racking systems
code_edition: National Building Code – 2023 Alberta Edition; National Fire Code – 2023 Alberta Edition

facts.text: The variance permits multi-level storage racking systems to be treated as special and unusual structures under Sentence 3.2.2.2.(1), subject to listed design conditions.
The design conditions restrict access to authorized personnel, limit permitted occupancies, and require a fire-safety plan submitted with the building permit application.
Conditions include structural design, sprinkler/fire-alarm and firefighting measures, lighting/emergency power, signage, and detailed exit and travel-distance requirements.
The document recommends seeking local fire-prevention or fire-department input before applying for a building permit.
